context: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 2.2 Recommended Dosage and Administration Dispense equal amounts (0.5 mL) of gel from Tube A and Tube B on the dosing guide. Immediately put the caps back on Tube A and Tube B tightly. Mix together on the dosing
el. ZELSUVMI is supplied as two tubes. Tube A with a blue label contains 14 grams of berdazimer gel and Tube B with a yellow label contains 17 grams of hydrogel.

THS Topical gel: 10.3% berdazimer in an opaque white to off-white gel. ZELSUVMI is supplied as two tubes. Tube A with a blue label contains 14 grams of berdazimer gel and Tube B with a yellow label contains 17 grams of hydrogel.
